ios.desc:
Transform Your Health with Itsmyfood

Take control of your health journey with Itsmyfood, the ultimate app designed to support your goals for healthy eating and weight loss. Whether you're tracking calories, planning meals, or analyzing your grocery choices, Itsmyfood is here to guide you every step of the way.

Achieve Your Goals, One Meal at a Time

Itsmyfood isn't just about counting calories—it's about understanding what you eat. Our comprehensive nutrient tracker ensures you get the vitamins and minerals your body needs, while our meal planner helps you create balanced meals tailored to your personal health objectives. Say goodbye to guesswork and hello to a healthier you!

Track Your Progress, Celebrate Your Success

Monitor your body's transformation with our easy-to-use tracking tools. Keep tabs on your weight, BMI, and body fat percentage, and visualize your progress with our photo diary feature. Itsmyfood makes it simple to stay motivated and see how far you've come.

Discover Delicious Recipes

Explore a world of healthy eating with our recipe book. Save your favorite snacks and meals, and add them to your meal plans with ease. With detailed nutritional information for each recipe, you can enjoy delicious food that aligns with your health goals.

Why Choose Itsmyfood?

Comprehensive Meal Planner
Recipe Book for Healthy Eating 
Calorie and Nutrient Tracker
Macro, Vitamin, and Mineral Tracking 
Body Progress Tracker  
Apple Health Integration

Sync your activity data with Itsmyfood using Apple Health. Track your steps, monitor your calorie burn, and stay on top of your fitness journey with seamless integration.

Get Started with Itsmyfood

Download Itsmyfood today for free and start your journey towards a healthier lifestyle. Unlock additional features with our Premium subscription, available on a monthly or annual basis. Manage your subscription easily through your iTunes account, and rest assured with our clear and transparent billing process.

Join the Itsmyfood Community

Ready to make healthy eating simple and sustainable? Download Itsmyfood now and take the first step toward your best self. For more details on our terms and privacy, visit itsmyfoodapp.com.

Your health, your food—made simple with Itsmyfood.
